title: main red: Dogfood Regression Gate — GET /packages/:id/customizations is ledgered but not mounted (#28595), so the route 404s at runtime
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Main-red anchor card, filed by triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Red

- **Runs:** `main` push `CI` is red on every head from `519089e1` (PR #28595, #28411 N-15) onward: `519089e1`, `20dcc075`, `7449e479`, `a9c6eac6`, `479ad08f` and `882fcdbe` (e.g. run `41287645615`).
- **The failing job:** `Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)`, which fails exactly one test: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood.test.ts` › "every ledgered route is reachably mounted". It says: `runtime/route-ledger.ts: GET /packages/:id/customizations — LEDGERED BUT NOT MOUNTED. The live router answers nothing for GET /api/v1/packages/__parity_probe_0/customizations`.
- **Deterministic, and a real defect, not a stale pin.** PR #28595 added the ledger row (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts:544`) and the domain handler (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:2532`). It did not add the HTTP mount. `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts` mounts each `/packages` sub-route explicitly through `mountPackagesRoute(...)` (18 calls, `/:id/export` at about :1589), and none names `/:id/customizations`. So the new read 404s for every caller at runtime. Its unit test (`packages-customizations.test.ts`) calls the domain handler directly, so it passes.
- **Why the queue let it through:** the CI workflow runs the `Dogfood Regression Gate (n/3)` shards only on `push`. They are skipped for `pull_request` and `merge_group` by design (`ci.yml` ~:2391). The first reading of this gate is therefore post-merge on `main`, and every later push carries the red.

## Stop-bleed (the only scope)

- Add the mount beside its sibling `/:id/export` in `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`:
  ```ts
  mountPackagesRoute('get', '/:id/customizations', (req) => `/${req.params.id}/customizations`);
  ```
  `/:id` is single-segment, so order does not shadow it, but keep it with the other two-segment GETs.
- Prove it with the gate itself: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test -- route-ledger-live-mount-parity` green, plus one HTTP-level probe of `GET /api/v1/packages/<installed base>/customizations` answering 200 (the gate checks only that a route resolves).
- ⛔ The fix is never to pin the row in `UNEXERCISED_BY_THIS_BOOT` or drop the ledger row: the route is meant to be live (#28411), and pinning would hide a 404 on a shipped read.

## Reader who acts

`domain:server`: the seat that landed PR #28595 (attribution `os-project-manager`), or any `domain:server` seat under the main-red anchor exception. Under #27047 item 6, a lane claims it this round. If it is unclaimed for one round, triage escalates by name. If it is still unclaimed after that, triage dispatches this stop-bleed.
